title: Three-Item Loneliness Scale
description: 3 questions about feeling left out, isolated and lacking companionship, each rated 1–3.

holder.name: Daniel W. Russell and colleagues (University of Chicago NSHAP team for the short form)

citation.text: Hughes ME, Waite LJ, Hawkley LC, Cacioppo JT (2004). A short scale for measuring loneliness in large surveys: results from two population-based studies. Research on Aging 26(6):655–672.

scoring.text: Sum of the 3 items (3–9); higher is lonelier. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
